ICS 35.030LITD 17Revised Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 2) (Second Revision) which is identical with ISO/IEC 27035-2 : 2023 ‘Information Technology Information security incident management Part 2: Guidelines to plan and prepare for incident response’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) jointly was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendations of the Information Systems Security and Privacy Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Information Technology Division Council.This standard was originally published in 2016 and was identical with ISO/IEC 27035 : 2011. The first revision of this standard was published in 2019 and was identical with ISO/IEC 27035-2 : 2016. The second revision of this standard aligns this Indian Standard with ISO/IEC 27035-2 : 2023.
